_meta.how_to: Copy this file to eval/gold_drop.json ONLY after the seal commit exists. Follow eval/drop_labelling/LABELLING_GUIDE.md. Delete the X-Example Deal entry, add one entry per new or changed deal (key = exact folder name). Check with: .venv/bin/python eval/drop_labelling/check_labels.py eval/gold_drop.json
_meta.history_notes: Free text: which H- ids you flagged and the 2+ links you saw for each; which look-alikes you refused to flag and why.

_field_help.status: todo | draft | done. Only draft/done are scored. Set done when finished.
_field_help.extracted: The 9 facts. ein as 12-3456789; money as a plain number; needed_by as 2026-11-06T15:00-06:00 or null; anything you cannot read = null (never guess). purpose_category, product from the enum lists in the guide.
_field_help.extracted_accept: Optional. {"field": [other fair answers]} when more than one answer is defensible (J7 revenue range). Else {}.
_field_help.issues: Issues still OPEN at the end of the week (J14). Grammar: MISSING_DOC:<doc>, MISSING_PAGE:<doc>, MISMATCH:<field>, OLD_TRICK:<code>.
_field_help.issues_optional: Defensible either way; neither rewarded nor penalised.
_field_help.routing: Who signs each gate (an id from contacts/teams.json, e.g. firstname.lastname). null for a gate the deal should never reach.
_field_help.final_stage: Furthest stage reached by end of week if every human approves promptly: Intake | Credit | Committee | Product | Committed | Closed.
_field_help.fraud.flagged_held: flagged and held are both true only for a hold (J17 old trick, or ring member). Both false for watch and clear.
_field_help.fraud.latest_ok_stage: Latest stage at which a hold still counts as on time. null if not flagged.
_field_help.fraud.linked_deals: Other current folder names and H- history ids in the same scheme. [] if none.
_field_help.notes: Your reasoning in one or two lines. Not scored.
